_info: Example file. Copy it to bindings.json (same folder) and change the copy. Help: docs/BINDINGS.md. Names that start with an underscore are notes, the program ignores them. 'user' sends shift+s (Resolve: add a node before the current one). '_shift_up+user' sends ctrl+alt+k (Resolve: open the Keyboard Shortcuts menu) and is switched off: remove the leading underscore from its name to activate it.
